license_note: FFmpeg-Builds win64 LGPL archive: it omits GPL-only components such as libx264, libx265 and libxvid, so the application can redistribute it. Bundled encoder options are chosen from the build's own encoder list by app/render.py; OpenH264 and VP9 are BSD, the native MPEG-4 Part 2 encoder is LGPL.
note: The archive is pinned to one dated auto-build release, never the moving 'latest' tag whose bytes change with every upstream rebuild, and the SHA-256 from that release's checksums.sha256 is checked on every fetch. Adopting a newer build means re-pinning this file after reviewing its licence and encoders.
